name: T12-WF13 - AI Renewal Management Agent

parameters.content:
## 1. Scheduled Scan
Daily renewal scan checks eligible active contracts due within the renewal window.

## 2. Contract & Customer Context
Retrieve authoritative contract details and calculate canonical urgency from stored dates.

## 3. AI Drafting & Grounding
AI generates renewal recommendation and proposal language. Grounding validation ensures source consistency.

## 4. Policy Gate & Delivery
Backend authoritative eligibility gate enforces consent and approval before sending; records attempts idempotently.

Do not invent discounts or dates outside the provided contract.' }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.2, responseMimeType: 'application/json' } } }}
